tagline: A systematic framework for diagnosing and recovering from catastrophic layer sensitivity in transformers — validated on GPT-2, scaling to Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B.
phase_status: Phase 11 complete (GPT-2 real GPU validation). Winning Ticket found at 30% sparsity. Next: Llama-3-8B and Mistral-7B on dual 3090 remote server.
research_question: Can temporal importance metrics — cheap proxy signals computed from gradient dynamics — reliably identify and exploit layer-level elasticity to achieve lossless (< 5% PPL) structured compression at 50%+ parameter reduction without retraining?

overview.title: What we're building
overview.body: A structured pruning + activation healing pipeline (TIM-MGDT) that identifies which transformer layers are elastic vs critical, prunes the elastic ones, and heals the activation drift — recovering perplexity while cutting parameters, latency, and memory by ~50%.

overview.title: Why this matters
overview.body: Existing pruning methods either destroy quality or require expensive retraining. We discovered that Layer 10 in GPT-2 is elastic, not broken — the +108% PPL explosion on hard removal shows over-weighting, not architectural damage. A 2% scaling fix restores balance. TIM-MGDT exploits this insight systematically.

overview.title: Where we are today
overview.body: Phase 11 complete — real GPU validation on GPT-2 (124M). Found a 30% sparsity Winning Ticket (+4.9% PPL only). Discovered that activation healing hurts GPT-2 (Conv1D architecture) but will massively help Llama/Mistral (nn.Linear). Next: 7B model runs on dual 3090s.

decisions.rationale: +108% PPL on hard removal = over-weighting. 2% scaling restores it. This insight drives the entire compression strategy.
+4.9% PPL only. Above 30%, PPL degrades rapidly (+21.3% at 40%) — classic phase transition boundary verified.

decisions.choice: Conv1D blocks immune → nn.Linear blocks will benefit massively
decisions.rationale: GPT-2 intermediate layers use Conv1D (unpruned by global linear pruning). Healing added noise. Llama/Mistral use nn.Linear everywhere — healing will recover massive quality loss.

decisions.choice: MHA is destructive; GQA will be far more tolerant
decisions.rationale: GPT-2 MHA: +59.3% PPL at 20% head pruning. Llama/Mistral GQA (8 KV groups for 32 Q heads) has built-in query redundancy → much safer.
Standard LM evaluation. Spearman ρ > 0.7 for proxy-to-ground-truth correlation. P-value < 0.05 for statistical significance.

decisions.choice: Apple Silicon (quick runs) → 2×3090 (48 GB, full runs)
decisions.rationale: Two-phase compute strategy. Remote SSH to dual 3090 for 7B models. See REMOTE_SETUP_GUIDE.md.
